2.69.15
Table.Visibility
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Table.Visibility element specifies the presentational presence of a Table. This element is optional
and is of type Visibility.
Following is the parent element of the Table.Visibility element.
Parent elements
Table
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Table.Visibility element.
 <xsd:element name="Visibility" type="VisibilityType" minOccurs="0" />
